description: Read-only contact analytics for HubSpot CRM — score drift, engagement decay, source ROI, and a daily digest, with a local store no other HubSpot tool ships.

novel_features.name: Engagement decay
novel_features.description: Find previously-active contacts who have gone dark, ranked by prior engagement intensity.

novel_features.name: Lifecycle stuck
novel_features.description: Surface contacts stuck in a lifecycle stage past team-median dwell time.

novel_features.name: Stale but valuable
novel_features.description: Find high-score, high-revenue contacts whose engagement has cooled — the VIPs going cold.

novel_features.name: Source ROI
novel_features.description: Rank contact acquisition sources by realized revenue and conversion, not raw volume.

novel_features.name: Score drift
novel_features.description: Find contacts whose HubSpot score dropped meaningfully over a window — leading indicator before lifecycle catches up.

novel_features.name: Owner overload
novel_features.description: Flag sales reps carrying more active contacts than team median, weighted by lifecycle stage.

novel_features.name: Silent after first touch
novel_features.description: Find contacts who engaged exactly once and then went silent — distinguish tire-kickers from genuine interest.

novel_features.name: Duplicate suspects
novel_features.description: Surface likely duplicate contacts via fuzzy match on email-local-part, normalized name, and company.

novel_features.name: Daily digest
novel_features.description: One-command morning briefing — new high-score contacts, biggest score drops, lifecycle promotions, freshly stale VIPs.
